claims.evidence: Witness report only shows stacked tyres with tread/sidewall text partially visible; no clear brand/model, tyre size/series, DOT/manufacturing date, or other proof of 'tokunbo' status.

risks.risk: Tyre size/fitment unknown (rim size, width/aspect/series), which can make the tyres unusable for the buyer’s car
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the complete size marking (e.g., 195/65R15) and rim size, plus any load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tyres with unknown fitment risk.

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact variant unknown, affecting performance and resale value
risks.proof: A close-up photo where the full brand name and model/variant text is readable on at least one tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unbranded/unknown model used tyres.

risks.risk: Tread depth/remaining life unknown; tyres may be near-worn-out despite visible tread
risks.proof: A photo/video showing tread depth measurement (tread gauge reading) at multiple grooves.

risks.risk: Damage status unknown (cuts, bulges, punctures, uneven wear, cracks) which can make tyres unsafe
risks.proof: A full inspection video/clip rotating each tyre to show no bulges, sidewall cracks, punctures, or repaired areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used tyres with possible wear/damage risk.

risks.risk: Tyre age and DOT/manufacturing date unknown; older tyres can have dry rot even if tread looks okay
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code/manufacturing date on the sidewall for each tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tyres with age-related risk.

risks.risk: Quantity and whether all tyres are the same size/model unknown; mismatched tyres reduce value and may be unsafe
risks.proof: A photo showing the total number of tyres included and that each tyre has the same size/model markings.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full sidewall markings (complete size like 195/65R15, load/speed rating).
Send a close-up where the brand name and exact model/variant are fully readable.
Send tread depth measurements (tread gauge readings) from at least 3 points per tyre.
Send a rotating inspection video showing any cuts, bulges, punctures, uneven wear, and sidewall cracks.
Send a clear photo of the DOT/manufacturing date code for each tyre.
Confirm the total number of tyres and show that all are the same size/model.
response.reason: The witness can confirm tyres are present, but key pricing drivers (exact size/model, tread depth, damage, and tyre age/DOT) are not readable or measured in the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable; proof is needed to price safely.
